Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 17 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 47 06 00 00 00 7F F7.

The MX prints its Model ID as two bytes, 7F 17, where the MOXF prints a group number (7F 1C) and a model ID; its bulk dump carries the byte count after them, and its checksum adds up from the byte count.

Parameter changes at 40-42 (Normal Voice) and 46-47 (Drum Voice) edit the voice in the Voice mode's edit buffer; Pull asks for each edit buffer (Normal Voice, Drum Voice, Performance), whichever mode the instrument is in.
